verdict.rationale: Recruitee documents a bearer-token company API that covers core objects: creating and listing candidates, adding profile fields, creating offers and talent pools, departments and locations, plus webhooks. Nothing in the pack shows the API matches what the UI can do. Many UI features listed in the product docs (offer letters/eSignatures, referrals, agency management, WhatsApp/texting, email, scheduling, templates, reporting) have no API counterpart in the evidence, and the separate Careers API token is explicitly limited to three endpoints. Missing for 10: any stated API–UI parity commitment, API coverage for messaging/scheduling/offer letters/referrals/reporting/team management, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent confirmation of coverage breadth.
